metadata.content:
The remaining double contour is not the redundant highlight. The actual cause is in the shared FlagshipCard appearance itself: it combines a physical border and an inset ring on every card:


border-cyan-300/40


ring-1 ring-inset ring-cyan-100/10


On selected cards, that ring is strengthened again via cardSelected with ring-cyan-100/24, so the first selected artifact can read as two concentric contours.
Do not change the shared primitive yet because that would affect every remaining Learning surface. Fix only the selected Corpus Explorer artifact card by neutralizing its inherited ring while preserving the electric-blue border/glow.

test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "inspect/runtime-certified-main" && \
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "f9a3e18ce61a6768f097c1a451a3cda87cde6d08" && \
test "$(git status --short)" = " M apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/regions/EducationalCorpusExplorer.tsx" && \
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(
    "apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/"
    "learning/regions/EducationalCorpusExplorer.tsx"
)

text = path.read_text()

old = '''                className="p-4 text-left"
'''

new = '''                className={cn(
                  "p-4 text-left",
                  selected && "ring-0",
                )}
'''

if text.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("expected exactly one artifact FlagshipCard className")

text = text.replace(old, new)

path.write_text(text)
PY

git diff --check && \
npm run build && \
printf '%s\n' "===== EDUCATIONAL CORPUS EXPLORER DIFF =====" && \
git diff -- \
apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge/learning/regions/EducationalCorpusExplorer.tsx && \
printf '%s\n' "===== STATUS =====" && \
git status --short
